title: 3 John (Christian Bible)
dateDisplay: Written in the first century CE, with the canon fixed in the following centuries
attributionNote: The text is anonymous or traditionally attributed; the attribution is part of the work's reception rather than a statement about the surviving author. The catalogue does not adjudicate it.
description: A short letter about hospitality and a disruptive leader. This is the book as received in Christian Bibles: the Textus Receptus Greek text beside the King James Version of 1611.
historicalContext: Letters attributed to other apostolic figures and circulated widely.
availabilityNote: Streamed from the Bolls Bible API. Verse references follow the KJV; the Greek text is the Textus Receptus, which differs from critical editions at some readings.
